title: &aThe Storage Network
subtitle: Applied Energistics 2: from a fallen meteorite to your first ME network and autocrafting.

quests.title: A Stone From the Sky
quests.subtitle: Applied Energistics 2
desc: &eApplied Energistics 2&r stores every item you own in one digital network. It starts with a &emeteorite&r: a crater with a sky-stone core holding inscriber presses and budding certus quartz.
AE2 has a full guide built in: hover any AE2 item and hold &eG&r. Find a meteorite (a Meteorite Compass helps once you have certus).

quests.title: Growing Certus
desc: &eBudding certus quartz&r grows crystal buds on its faces. Harvest the fully grown clusters for &eCertus Quartz Crystals&r. Breaking a budding block downgrades it, so leave them where they are and harvest around them.
A &eGrowth Accelerator&r next to them speeds things up a lot.

quests.title: Charged Certus
desc: A &eCharger&r puts power into certus crystals. It needs energy: AE2 takes FE (from a Create alternator or Mekanism) through an Energy Acceptor, or you can crank it by hand.
Make Charged Certus Quartz.

quests.title: Fluix
desc: Drop charged certus, redstone and nether quartz into water together: they react into &eFluix Crystals&r.
Fluix makes cables and most network parts. Make a stack's worth over time.

quests.title: The Four Presses
desc: Meteorite cores hold &eInscriber Presses&r: logic, calculation, engineering and silicon. Search every meteorite you find; you need all four.
An Inscriber can copy a press from an iron block, so one set is enough for the whole party.

quests.title: The Inscriber
desc: The &eInscriber&r presses materials between presses. It prints circuits (gold, certus, diamond) and silicon, then joins them with redstone into processors.
Build one.

quests.title: Processors
desc: Every smart network part needs processors: &eLogic&r (gold), &eCalculation&r (certus) and &eEngineering&r (diamond).
Make one of each. Automate them later with the Inscriber and a few hoppers.

quests.title: The ME Controller
desc: The &eME Controller&r is the brain of the network. Power it through an &eEnergy Acceptor&r (FE in, AE out) and connect everything to it with cable.
Without a controller a small network still works, but with one you get many more channels.

quests.title: Drives and Cells
desc: Items live on &eStorage Cells&r (1k, 4k, 16k, 64k, 256k) inside an &eME Drive&r. A cell holds a set number of item types and a total amount.
Craft a storage cell and an ME Drive.

quests.title: Cables and Channels
desc: Every device uses a &echannel&r. Normal cable carries 8, dense cable 32, and each face of the controller sends out 32. Run out and devices go dark.
A &eNetwork Tool&r shows channel use. Fluix glass cable is the place to start.

quests.title: One Chest to Rule Them All
desc: A &eCrafting Terminal&r on the network shows everything you've stored and lets you craft straight from it. Search it like JEI.
Put one where your whole party can reach it: every item, everyone's, in one place.

quests.title: The Storage Bus
desc: A &eStorage Bus&r on a chest, a barrel or a Mekanism bin lets the network use that container as storage. Import and export buses move items in and out of machines.
Hook your old chests into the network.

quests.title: Patterns
quests.subtitle: Autocrafting, part 1
desc: A &ePattern Encoding Terminal&r writes recipes onto blank patterns. A pattern tells the network how to make one thing.
Encode a pattern for something you craft often.

quests.title: The Crafting CPU
quests.subtitle: Autocrafting, part 2
desc: A &eCrafting CPU&r is a block of crafting units with at least one crafting storage inside. It plans and tracks every autocrafting job.
More storage, bigger jobs; more co-processors, faster jobs.

quests.title: Hands for the Network
quests.subtitle: Autocrafting, part 3
desc: A &ePattern Provider&r holds your patterns and sends ingredients out. Put a &eMolecular Assembler&r next to it for crafting-table recipes, or face it at a machine (a furnace, a Create press, a Mekanism enricher) for processing.
Now ask the terminal for 64 of something and watch it happen.

quests.title: Network Online
desc: Storage, terminals, buses and autocrafting: your base thinks for itself now.
From here: wireless terminals, P2P tunnels, spatial storage. The AE2 guide (hold &eG&r) covers them all.
